Badges.Name: Sharpshooter
Badges.Description: Landed the most musket hits this match. Every bullet had an address.

Badges.Name: Wall of Steel
Badges.Description: Parried the most shots. Bullets went in, ripostes came out.

Badges.Name: Bonk Lord
Badges.Description: Bumped into other musketeers more than anyone. Personal space is merely a suggestion.

Badges.Name: Regicide
Badges.Description: Brought down the Crowned leader. Heavy is the head that wears the crown, and lighter once you're done with it.

Badges.Name: Pacifist
Badges.Description: Dealt zero damage the whole match. A true man of peace, or just a terrible shot.
